text: MCP: suggest_repo_links — match a graph's open ideas against other local graphs' portable mission line (meta), never their ideas
description:
OBSERVED 2026-11-23: to wire 9 ~/dev graphs into Felix's life graph, the agent matched life ideas to repos with a keyword script over every graph's idea texts. That reads the other graphs' internals, which e81b11c3 rules out for links.

Felix 2026-11-23 shaped it: "support subtitles, and deliver top 3 intrinsically valuable ideas." Each graph describes itself to others by (1) an optional subtitle in meta.json (one line, editable) and (2) its up to 3 ideas with the highest intrinsic value: what the graph says matters most to it, not its internals. suggest_repo_links(graph) matches the calling graph's open ideas against these self-descriptions of the other local graphs (embeddings) and returns ranked (idea, repo, similarity, the matched line) candidates. It only suggests; link_repo does the linking. The subtitle is a new optional meta field, so it goes through a data model migration.

Refuted if the suggestions are mostly wrong for Felix's life graph.

status.comment: Accepted by Felix 2026-11-23 with the shape: subtitle + top 3 ideas by intrinsic value as each graph's self-description.
